data.text: The VIDYA School is a recognized English-medium institution affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, up to Senior Secondary level.

items.title: Senior Secondary Status
items.description: Co-educational English-medium school following the national NCERT curriculum framework.

items.title: NCERT & NEP Aligned
items.description: Strict compliance with all National Education Policy and CBSE examination guidelines.

items.title: Statutory Certifications
items.description: Valid building safety, fire safety, health hygiene, and drinking water certificates.
